exposure: Apgar score in the first minute ≤ 5
cohort: 22 neonates diagnosed with neonatal pneumothorax (NP) out of 11425 neonates born in Tuzla Canton within a three-year period, from January 2015 to December 2017
finding: The incidence of neonatal pneumothorax was 0.20% of total births and 3.64% of those treated in NICU, with significant differences in birth weight, gestational age, Caesarean section, length of mechanical ventilation, surfactant replacement therapy, and outcome between neonates who received mechanical ventilation and those who did not.
mod_finding: Neonates who required mechanical ventilation and developed pneumothorax had significantly lower gestational age and birth weight and were more likely to have been born via cesarean section compared to those who developed spontaneous pneumothorax.
